{{Top|leg}}
The '''Premion Mk. II power generator''' was a powerful [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] produced by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to power [[Multi-Troop Transport/Legends|MTTs]].<ref name="Complete Vehicles">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2013)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'']]</ref> The specific function of the generator was to power the transport's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine.
